response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and diverse programming experience, he lacks critical required qualifications for this role. Most significantly, there is no evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicit requirement. His career has primarily focused on web, mobile, and full-stack development with TypeScript/JavaScript, while this position requires deep expertise in embedded firmware development, Linux kernel internals, C programming, and network security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF). His last substantial C programming work was over a decade ago, and he has no demonstrated experience with embedded networking security technologies or switch/networking domain knowledge.
strengths: Extensive multi-language programming experience and proven ability to quickly learn new technical domains across diverse technology stacks
Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and infrastructure automation with DevOps experience
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring capabilities with experience organizing developer training programs and managing open-source projects
concerns: No evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is explicitly required for this position
Career focused on web/full-stack and mobile development with no embedded systems, firmware, or Linux kernel development experience
No demonstrated experience with network security technologies, protocols (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF), or network switch domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: Embedded systems and Linux kernel expertise
Network security and protocol domain knowledge
